question: Round-004 B stays: one dense table, same columns, fixed-width pick pills. You said "B is best in general but we can work on details". How much should one row tell you? Same 12 answers in each. In B, click a row to open it.

variants.label: Quieter
variants.changes: "Work on details" by taking away: date, round, pick and reason only. The Tags column goes, tags follow the reason as muted text. An empty reason shows a dash.

variants.label: Same row, click to expand
variants.changes: Round-004 B's row unchanged. A click opens a detail row under it: the winning variant's label and changes, the round question, and the theme and view of the answer. The two newest rows start open.

variants.label: Richer row
variants.changes: Everything in the row: the pick pill also names the winning variant ("a · Calm blue"), the round links to its compare screen, and two small icons show theme (sun or moon) and view (columns or flip), with tooltips.
